verses.en: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.pt: Tendo tédio à minha vida; darei livre curso à minha queixa, falarei na amargura da minha alma:
verses.en_web: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.en_bbe: My soul is tired of life; I will let my sad thoughts go free in words; my soul will make a bitter outcry.

verses.en: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
verses.pt: Direi a Deus: Não me condenes; faze-me saber por que contendes comigo.
verses.en_web: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
verses.en_bbe: I will say to God, Do not put me down as a sinner; make clear to me what you have against me.

verses.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.pt: Tens prazer em oprimir, em desprezar a obra das tuas mãos e favorecer o desígnio dos ímpios?
verses.en_web: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
verses.en_bbe: What profit is it to you to be cruel, to give up the work of your hands, looking kindly on the design of evil-doers?

verses.en: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
verses.pt: Tens tu olhos de carne? Ou vês tu como vê o homem?
verses.en_web: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?
verses.en_bbe: Have you eyes of flesh, or do you see as man sees?

verses.en: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man’s days,
verses.pt: São os teus dias como os dias do homem? Ou são os teus anos como os anos de um homem,
verses.en_web: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
verses.en_bbe: Are your days as the days of man, or your years like his,

verses.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?
verses.pt: para te informares da minha iniqüidade, e averiguares o meu pecado,
verses.en_web: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
verses.en_bbe: That you take note of my sin, searching after my wrongdoing,

verses.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.
verses.pt: ainda que tu sabes que eu não sou ímpio, e que não há ninguém que possa livrar-me da tua mão?
verses.en_web: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.
verses.en_bbe: Though you see that I am not an evil-doer; and there is no one who is able to take a man out of your hands?

verses.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
verses.pt: As tuas mãos me fizeram e me deram forma; e te voltas agora para me consumir?
verses.en_web: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.
verses.en_bbe: Your hands made me, and I was formed by you, but then, changing your purpose, you gave me up to destruction.

verses.en: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
verses.pt: Lembra-te, pois, de que do barro me formaste; e queres fazer-me tornar ao pó?
verses.en_web: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
verses.en_bbe: O keep in mind that you made me out of earth; and will you send me back again to dust?

verses.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.pt: Não me vazaste como leite, e não me coalhaste como queijo?
verses.en_web: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.en_bbe: Was I not drained out like milk, becoming hard like cheese?

verses.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
verses.pt: De pele e carne me vestiste, e de ossos e nervos me teceste.
verses.en_web: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
verses.en_bbe: By you I was clothed with skin and flesh, and joined together with bones and muscles.

verses.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
verses.pt: Vida e misericórdia me tens concedido, e a tua providência me tem conservado o espírito.
verses.en_web: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
verses.en_bbe: You have been kind to me, and your grace has been with me, and your care has kept my spirit safe.

verses.en: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.
verses.pt: Contudo ocultaste estas coisas no teu coração; bem sei que isso foi o teu desígnio.
verses.en_web: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:
verses.en_bbe: But you kept these things in the secret of your heart; I am certain this was in your thoughts:

verses.en: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
verses.pt: Se eu pecar, tu me observas, e da minha iniqüidade não me absolverás.
verses.en_web: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: That, if I did wrong, you would take note of it, and would not make me clear from sin:

verses.en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
verses.pt: Se for ímpio, ai de mim! Se for justo, não poderei levantar a minha cabeça, estando farto de ignomínia, e de contemplar a minha miséria.
verses.en_web: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still shall not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.
verses.en_bbe: That, if I was an evil-doer, the curse would come on me; and if I was upright, my head would not be lifted up, being full of shame and overcome with trouble.

verses.en: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.pt: Se a minha cabeça se exaltar, tu me caças como a um leão feroz; e de novo fazes maravilhas contra mim.
verses.en_web: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.
verses.en_bbe: And that if there was cause for pride, you would go after me like a lion; and again put out your wonders against me:

verses.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.
verses.pt: Tu renovas contra mim as tuas testemunhas, e multiplicas contra mim a tua ira; reveses e combate estão comigo.
verses.en_web: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.
verses.en_bbe: That you would send new witnesses against me, increasing your wrath against me, and letting loose new armies on me.

verses.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
verses.pt: Por que, pois, me tiraste da madre? Ah! se então tivera expirado, e olhos nenhuns me vissem!
verses.en_web: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.
verses.en_bbe: Why then did you make me come out of my mother's body? It would have been better for me to have taken my last breath, and for no eye to have seen me,

verses.en: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.pt: Então fora como se nunca houvera sido; e da madre teria sido levado para a sepultura.
verses.en_web: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.en_bbe: And for me to have been as if I had not been; to have been taken from my mother's body straight to my last resting-place.

verses.en: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.pt: Não são poucos os meus dias? Cessa, pois, e deixa-me, para que por um pouco eu tome alento;
verses.en_web: Aren’t my days few? Cease then. Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,
verses.en_bbe: Are not the days of my life small in number? Let your eyes be turned away from me, so that I may have a little pleasure,

verses.en: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
verses.pt: antes que me vá para o lugar de que não voltarei, para a terra da escuridão e das densas trevas,
verses.en_web: before I go where I shall not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;
verses.en_bbe: Before I go to the place from which I will not come back, to the land where all is dark and black,

verses.en: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
verses.pt: terra escuríssima, como a própria escuridão, terra da sombra trevosa e do caos, e onde a própria luz é como a escuridão.
verses.en_web: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
verses.en_bbe: A land of thick dark, without order, where the very light is dark.
